_comment: NET.3 (Lucas, Discord 2026-11-12): the hosts each app's pages may reach with fetch/XHR in the desktop app. build.mjs --strict-hosts turns this into a Content-Security-Policy connect-src header in shell.json (hosts.mjs; the Rust protocol handler already sends shell.json headers with every page). Only connect-src is set: links, images, fonts and frames are not changed. Studio (the suite) gets every app's list. test/hosts.test.mjs scans each app's source and fails when a request URL names a host that is in neither `apps` nor `reference`. Keep `why` true: name the file that makes the request.

always.getcadcraft.com: the Library, sign-in pages, Hailey, the add-on list, the hardware report (when on), help

bimcraft.power.larc.nasa.gov: solar and temperature climatology for a site (data-packs.js)
bimcraft.re.jrc.ec.europa.eu: PVGIS monthly irradiation for a site (data-packs.js)

_not_covered: Servers the person types in are not on any list: CivilCraft map servers (WMS/WMTS/ArcGIS in gis-map-ui.js) and anything an add-on added later from the Library reaches. With --strict-hosts those requests are refused, which is why the flag is off by default until a per-person 'also allow' list exists in the shell.
